walls.note: Front: lettered face and the bust three-quarter view (Commons 4133292208, RCE 20536120; panorama 01395 shows the bust in profile from the south-west).

items.where: bronze bust of Multatuli: head with high forehead, heavy brow, drooping moustache and swept-back hair, chest and shoulders tapering to a point, left arm a stump, bow tie
items.how: builder: ellipsoid head and hair mass, brow ridge, nose, moustache and chin boxes, ear balls, tapered chest cylinder, shoulder ellipsoid, two arm stumps, collar band and three-part bow tie; no skin texture or coat folds

items.where: block of polished red granite, 2.0 x 1.2 m and 1.05 m high, on a thin pale plinth slab
MULTATULI in light serif capitals on the front face of the block
items.how: builder: raised stroke-font capitals (letterBoxes) in cream; the real lettering is mixed-case serif, cut in

walls.note: Side: plain granite face; the bust from the side shows the left-arm stump (RCE 20536120).
Back: plain granite face, bust seen from behind; not photographed.

sources.name: Paul van Galen / RCE, Brug 9 Torensluis, standbeeld van Multatuli (20536120, 20536118)
